# Officevibe — Style Reference

> bond paper under a cobalt desk lamp, one italic word inked by hand. A regular-weight grotesk sets the page on white, Plantin-style italics carry the feeling, hairlines stay near-invisible, and one cobalt pill marks every decision.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Officevibe speaks a paper-and-italics product language: a white canvas (#ffffff) holds near-white panels (#fafafa, #f9f8f6, #f3f3f3), and a single deep navy (#0c1754) inverts only the footer. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue, cobalt #2545ff, with two tints (#c8d0ff, #dbdfec). It is rationed to pill CTAs, outline borders, link text, checklist icons, a 10%-opacity card shadow and decorative gradient tiles. The typography thesis is the interruption: ABC Favorit at weight 400 sets every headline, then a serif italic (Martina Plantijn) takes over mid-sentence for the emotional phrase, "not paying attention". Hierarchy comes from size and tracking alone. The display steps alternate Perfect Fourth and Perfect Fifth jumps (27 → 36 → 54 → 72 → 108px), and tracking tightens from −0.02em to −0.05em as type grows. Shape is binary: 100px pills for actions and 24px for containers. Elevation is soft and cobalt-tinted rather than grey. The whole reads as an editorial magazine about managers rather than a dashboard vendor.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cobalt Signal | `#2545ff` | `--color-cobalt-signal` | Primary pill fills, 2px outline borders, "Take action" link text and checklist ticks (7 fills, 11 text, 9 borders) — the only saturated hue in the system. Do not use it for body text or large background fields. |
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page body, nav bar, floating mockup chips and text on cobalt pills (15 fills, 14 text uses) — the neutral stage that lets cobalt read as a decision. |
| Fog Panel | `#fafafa` | `--color-fog-panel` | AI feature cards and the large "How it works" panel (9 uses) — a 2% shift from white that separates without drawing a line. |
| Linen Reverse | `#f9f8f6` | `--color-linen-reverse` | Footer text, footer ghost-button border and warm secondary panels (34 text uses, 8 fills) — a warm off-white that softens the navy inversion. |
| Concrete Tile | `#f3f3f3` | `--color-concrete-tile` | Inner tiles, FAQ rows and image placeholders (8 uses) — the deepest neutral step before inversion. |
| Frosted Banner | `#c8d0ff` | `--color-frosted-banner` | Announcement bar fill only (1 use) — a cobalt tint that marks news without spending the full accent. Do not use it as a card fill. |
| Onyx Ink | `#171417` | `--color-onyx-ink` | Headlines, hero body copy, eyebrows and "Log in" (67 uses, the most frequent color) — a near-black with a faint warm-violet cast that keeps ink from reading as pure #000000. |
| Graphite Nav | `#222222` | `--color-graphite-nav` | Nav links and FAQ answer paragraphs (19 uses) — one step lighter than Onyx Ink, so it reads as wayfinding rather than content. |
| Pewter Caption | `#484747` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Captions, secondary descriptions and fine print (13 uses) — the tertiary text tier, kept dark enough for AA contrast on #fafafa. |
| Quartz Border | `#e6e6e4` | `--color-quartz-border` | 1px card outlines on AI feature cards (8 uses) — a warm hairline that defines edges without boxing content in. |
| Mist Rule | `#dbdfec` | `--color-mist-rule` | 1px ring on the chat widget's circular icon button — a blue-grey hairline used only where glass meets white. |
| Indigo Vault | `#0c1754` | `--color-indigo-vault` | Footer background and the dark end of cobalt gradient tiles (1 fill, 2 text uses) — the inverted surface, cobalt pushed to midnight. Do not use it for mid-page section bands. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Abcfavoritvariable — the display grotesk, always at weight 400, carrying every headline and eyebrow · `--font-abcfavoritvariable`

- **Substitute:** Hanken Grotesk at 450, Familjen Grotesk at 400, Schibsted Grotesk at 400. Favorit's Regular draws slightly heavier than a nominal 400 because of its wide, open bowls, so nudge thin-drawing substitutes up by 50.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 14px, 16px, 27px, 36px, 45px, 54px, 72px, 108px
- **Line height:** 1.4 (14–16px), 1.1 (27–54px), 1.0 (72–108px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0 at 14px and 16px (uppercase), −0.54px at 27px, −0.72px at 36px, −0.9px at 45px, −1.08px at 54px, −3.6px at 72px, −5.4px at 108px
- **OpenType features:** `"ss01"`, `"ss04"`
- **Role:** A single weight across a 14–108px range is the signature. Headlines grow massive without getting louder, which is the opposite of the SaaS convention of 600–700 display weights. Tracking holds at −0.02em through 54px, then jumps to −0.05em at 72px and above, so the hero locks into a dense slab while section heads stay airy. At 14px and 16px uppercase it doubles as the eyebrow voice, so even the smallest labels carry the display face.

### Inter hosted — the UI and reading workhorse for paragraphs, nav, buttons and lists · `--font-inter-hosted`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400/500/700 (identical metrics), Geist at 400/500/700, Public Sans at 400/500/700. All three match stroke weight at their nominal values.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 700
- **Sizes:** 13.5px, 14px, 15.75px, 16px, 18px
- **Line height:** 1.0 (13.5px uppercase), 1.1 (18px buttons), 1.4 (13.5px, 14px, 18px), 1.6 (16px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0.675px at 13.5px uppercase, 0 elsewhere
- **OpenType features:** `"ss01"`, `"ss04"`
- **Role:** Inter at 400 for 18px body copy (62 uses) is the workhorse. The 18px base is deliberately larger than the 16px convention and is consistent with a 9px grid where 18 is two units. Weight 500 is reserved for interactive labels (buttons, "Log in"), so medium weight itself signals clickability. Weight 700 appears only at 13.5px for inline emphasis, such as "at risk" inside mockup chips.

### Martinaplantijn — the serif italic interjection, a Plantin-lineage book face swapped into headlines mid-sentence · `--font-martinaplantijn`

- **Substitute:** Crimson Pro italic at 500, Source Serif 4 italic at 400, Newsreader italic at 450. Plantin is sturdy and large-bodied, and Crimson Pro draws lighter, so push it to 500 to match the stroke.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 45px, 54px, 72px, 108px
- **Line height:** 1.1 (45–54px), 1.0 (72–108px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0 at 45px, 54px and 72px weight 400; −3.6px at 72px weight 500; −5.4px at 108px weight 500
- **OpenType features:** `"ss01"`, `"ss04"`
- **Role:** The serif never sets a whole headline. It replaces the two or three words that carry feeling, rendered italic at exactly the grotesk's size and line height so the baseline does not jump. It is the system's voice of empathy, a book face where a competitor would reach for a color highlight. Six uses on the entire page is the correct dosage.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter hosted | 400 | 13.5px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Abcfavoritvariable | 400 | 14px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter hosted | 400 | 16px | 1.6 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter hosted | 400 | 18px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| subheading | Abcfavoritvariable | 400 | 27px | 1.1 | -0.54px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Abcfavoritvariable | 400 | 36px | 1.1 | -0.72px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Abcfavoritvariable | 400 | 45px | 1.1 | -0.9px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Abcfavoritvariable | 400 | 54px | 1.1 | -1.08px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Abcfavoritvariable | 400 | 72px | 1.0 | -3.6px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Abcfavoritvariable at weight 400, from 27px to 108px — size and tracking carry rank, so weight stays constant and the voice stays calm.
- Swap two or three emotional words per headline into Martinaplantijn italic at the identical size and line-height (e.g. 72px/1.0) — the serif interjection is the signature and only works as an interruption.
- Tighten tracking to −0.02em up to 54px and to −0.05em at 72px and above (−3.6px at 72px) — the hero must lock into a slab while section heads breathe.
- Build all spacing from the 9px unit: 9, 18, 27, 36, 54, 90px — the 9px grid is why 18px body and 27px gaps feel proportionate.
- Shape every action as a 100px pill with a 2px border, filled #2545ff for primary and outlined for secondary — identical geometry makes rank legible through fill alone.
- Tint elevation with cobalt: `rgba(37, 69, 255, 0.1) 0px 4px 8px 0px` on cards — shadows in the brand hue keep depth on-palette at 10% opacity.
- Separate surfaces with 2–6% tonal steps (#ffffff → #fafafa → #f3f3f3) and a #e6e6e4 hairline — panels define themselves without heavy outlines.

### Don't

- Don't bold the display face to 600 or 700 at 54px — the thesis is quiet authority, and heavy headlines turn the editorial tone into a generic SaaS shout.
- Don't set an entire headline in Martinaplantijn or use it below 45px — the serif becomes a theme instead of an interjection, and the empathy beat disappears.
- Don't introduce a second saturated hue (teal, orange, green) for CTAs or section bands — the chromatic budget is one cobalt #2545ff, and that limit is non-negotiable.
- Don't add grey drop shadows above 0.15 opacity to cards — the system's heaviest shadow is `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 0px 2px 15px 0px` on a 24px widget button, and anything darker reads as a 2015 dashboard.
- Don't round cards to 8px or square off buttons to 6px — the vocabulary is 100px for actions and 24px for containers, and mid-range radii blur that binary.
- Don't drop body copy to 14px on desktop — 18px Inter at 400 is the 62-use workhorse, and shrinking it breaks both the 9px rhythm and the generous reading pace.
- Don't fill mid-page sections with #0c1754 — the navy is reserved for the footer, and repeating it fragments the white-paper canvas into a striped landing page.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- card surface: #fafafa (Fog Panel)
- primary text: #171417 (Onyx Ink)
- nav and secondary text: #222222 (Graphite Nav)
- hairline: #e6e6e4 (Quartz Border)
- inverted footer: #0c1754 (Indigo Vault)
- primary action: #2545ff (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use a single #2545ff line on white, with an area fill of #2545ff at 10% opacity and neutral #e6e6e4 gridlines. Positive and negative deltas appear only as small tinted badges that are mockup-internal, so cobalt never outweighs the 72px headline on the same screen.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #2545ff, text #ffffff, border 2px solid #2545ff, border-radius 100px, padding 9px 27px, height 42px, font-family Inter at 18px weight 500, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing 0, and no box-shadow. Add a section-size variant with padding 13px 36px and height 49px. Pair it with a secondary outline pill that has a transparent background, text #2545ff and an identical 2px #2545ff border, placed 18px to the right.

2. Build the hero section: a white (#ffffff) area inside a 1440px container with 144px top padding, split into two equal columns. In the left column, place an eyebrow "EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT" in Abcfavoritvariable (fallback Hanken Grotesk 450) at 14px weight 400, uppercase, color #171417. Leave 18px, then an h1 at 72px weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing −3.6px, color #171417, where the phrase "not paying attention" switches to Martinaplantijn italic (fallback Crimson Pro italic 500) at weight 500, 72px, letter-spacing −3.6px. Follow with 27px gap, an 18px Inter paragraph at weight 400, line-height 1.4, max-width 630px, then 36px gap and the primary pill, then 45px gap and five greyscale logos spaced 36px apart. In the right column, float three white chips with 18px radius, padding 9px 13px and shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 4px 16px.

3. Build an AI feature card row: three cards in a 3-column grid with 27px gaps. Each card has background #fafafa, border 1px solid #e6e6e4, border-radius 24px, box-shadow rgba(37,69,255,0.1) 0 4px 8px, padding 0 and overflow hidden. The top half holds a mockup image on #f3f3f3 with 18px inner radius. The bottom text block has 20px padding, a 27px Abcfavoritvariable title at weight 400 with line-height 1.1 and letter-spacing −0.54px in #171417, 9px gap, then an 18px Inter description at weight 400 in #484747.

4. Build the navigation bar: a static, non-sticky bar, height 66px, background #ffffff, no border or shadow, content inside a 1440px container. The left side holds the wordmark, then 27px gap, then links in Inter 18px weight 400 color #222222 with padding 20px 18px. The right side holds "Log in" in Inter 18px weight 500 color #171417, an outline pill "Let's chat" (transparent, 2px solid #2545ff, text #2545ff, radius 100px, padding 9px 27px), and a filled pill "Book a demo" (#2545ff fill, #ffffff text, same geometry), with 9px between items.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Abcfavoritvariable at weight 400, from 27px to 108px — size and tracking carry rank, so weight stays constant and the voice stays calm.
- Swap two or three emotional words per headline into Martinaplantijn italic at the identical size and line-height (e.g. 72px/1.0) — the serif interjection is the signature and only works as an interruption.
- Tighten tracking to −0.02em up to 54px and to −0.05em at 72px and above (−3.6px at 72px) — the hero must lock into a slab while section heads breathe.
- Build all spacing from the 9px unit: 9, 18, 27, 36, 54, 90px — the 9px grid is why 18px body and 27px gaps feel proportionate.
- Shape every action as a 100px pill with a 2px border, filled #2545ff for primary and outlined for secondary — identical geometry makes rank legible through fill alone.
- Tint elevation with cobalt: `rgba(37, 69, 255, 0.1) 0px 4px 8px 0px` on cards — shadows in the brand hue keep depth on-palette at 10% opacity.
- Separate surfaces with 2–6% tonal steps (#ffffff → #fafafa → #f3f3f3) and a #e6e6e4 hairline — panels define themselves without heavy outlines.

### Don't

- Don't bold the display face to 600 or 700 at 54px — the thesis is quiet authority, and heavy headlines turn the editorial tone into a generic SaaS shout.
- Don't set an entire headline in Martinaplantijn or use it below 45px — the serif becomes a theme instead of an interjection, and the empathy beat disappears.
- Don't introduce a second saturated hue (teal, orange, green) for CTAs or section bands — the chromatic budget is one cobalt #2545ff, and that limit is non-negotiable.
- Don't add grey drop shadows above 0.15 opacity to cards — the system's heaviest shadow is `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 0px 2px 15px 0px` on a 24px widget button, and anything darker reads as a 2015 dashboard.
- Don't round cards to 8px or square off buttons to 6px — the vocabulary is 100px for actions and 24px for containers, and mid-range radii blur that binary.
- Don't drop body copy to 14px on desktop — 18px Inter at 400 is the 62-use workhorse, and shrinking it breaks both the 9px rhythm and the generous reading pace.
- Don't fill mid-page sections with #0c1754 — the navy is reserved for the footer, and repeating it fragments the white-paper canvas into a striped landing page.

## Imagery

There is no photography as content. The visual narrative is carried by recomposed product UI: survey reports, engagement gauges, AI coach chips and Slack notifications, cut apart and floated as white cards with 18px radius over either the white canvas or 27px-radius cobalt gradient tiles that fade from #0c1754 to #2545ff. Avatars appear only as small circular crops (50%) inside mockups. Icons are thin-stroke outline glyphs (trophy, target, sparkle, circle-check) drawn in #171417 or #2545ff. A grainy cobalt-to-lavender wave gradient sweeps behind the "How it works" panel, and it is decorative only, not a system token. Hand-drawn orange arrows and Slack's brand colors are decorative and mockup-internal. Customer logos sit in a five-up greyscale row. The story is the manager's dashboard at the moment it notices something.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1440px max-width container (900px for centered intro copy) on a 1920px canvas, with section gaps of 90px stretching to 144px around the hero. The hero is a 2-column split: eyebrow, 72px headline with serif interjection, 18px paragraph, one filled pill and a five-logo row on the left, and a floating cluster of signal chips on the right. Sections then alternate between the full-width "How it works" sheet with a 3-column vignette row, a 3-column AI feature card grid, and 2-column copy/mockup splits that swap sides each row. There is no pricing grid on the home page. The nav is static, filled white and 66px tall, with the wordmark and links left and the login and pill pair right. The footer is a full-bleed navy block with 90px vertical padding. At 375px, drop the hero to 45px (the heading token) and section gaps to 54px. Overall density: spacious.

## Italic Interjection

The discipline is a two-face headline where the serif is a voice change rather than a decoration. Abcfavoritvariable at 400 carries the sentence, and Martinaplantijn italic lands on the words that name a feeling ("not paying attention") at exactly the same size, line-height and tracking. Three things break it: setting a whole headline in the serif, using the serif for body or buttons, or giving the italic a different size or a color such as #2545ff. In each case the interruption stops being an interruption. To extend the system, allow one interjection per headline, cap it at roughly a third of the words, use it only at 45px and above, and keep it in #171417. Emphasis then arrives as tone of voice, unlike the conventional highlighter-colored keyword.

## Cobalt Rationing

The chromatic budget is one hue: #2545ff, with #c8d0ff and #dbdfec as its tints and #0c1754 as its night. Cobalt may fill pills, draw 2px outlines, color action links and ticks, tint shadows at 10% and paint product tiles. It may not color paragraphs, fill whole page bands or serve as a large headline color. Adding a second accent (a green "success" CTA, an orange highlight) breaks it immediately, because the page currently teaches that cobalt equals decision. To extend, derive new needs from the existing ramp: a hover state at #0c1754, a selected chip on #c8d0ff, and data series as cobalt at 100%, 40% and 10%. That is more restrained than the multi-hue palettes common in HR software.

## Nine-Pixel Grid

The site runs on 9px, not the conventional 8px: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45, 54, 72, 90, 108 and 144px account for over 400 measured spacing values. The type scale follows the same grid, with 18px body, 27px subheads and display sizes of 36, 45, 54, 72 and 108px, so text and gaps snap to one lattice. Mixing in 8px-system values such as 24px, 32px or 48px breaks it, because they drift off the grid by 3px per step and the rhythm visibly loosens. The measured 13px, 16px and 20px are tolerated exceptions for chip padding, icons and card insets. Extend only in 9px multiples, and for new sizes reuse an existing token rather than interpolating.
